published_selection_rule: One row per firm key: keep only firms whose earliest award_year in the frozen file is a Phase I award from 2005 through 2018, with no earlier Phase II or Phase III record and with the four-year label window closed. Later Phase II records from the same firm key and agency define the target; no outcome field is used to select rows.
limits: No new judgment, source reconstruction, or model fit was performed.
This verifies input and output records, not the model's hidden reasoning.
The effect of exclusions on predictive scores is not measured.
No counterfactual review tests whether supplying the omitted declaration would change acceptance.
